items: Emerging technologies woh naye tools, systems aur tareeqe hain jo abhi ban rahe hain ya jin ka istemal abhi shuru hua hai.
AI se murad aisi machines aur software hain jo insaan ki tarah soch aur seekh sakte hain.
Cloud computing mein log data aur applications apne computer ya server ki bajaye internet par rakhte aur istemal karte hain.
Blockchain bohat se computers par maloomat record aur share karne ka mehfooz tareeqa hai; ise badalna ya hack karna taqreeban na-mumkin hai.
IoT fridge, gari aur kapron jaisi rozmarra cheezon ko internet se jorta hai; yeh data bhejti aur leti hain aur zindagi aasan banati hain.
AR smartphone ya ainak se asal duniya mein digital cheezein jorta hai.
VR poora virtual environment banata hai jis mein khaas equipment se kaam kiya jata hai.
Quantum computers quantum physics ke usoolon se aam computers se kahin tez maloomat process karte hain.
Biotechnology mein bacteria aur paudon jaisi jaandar cheezon se naye products banaye ya masail hal kiye jate hain.
Virtualization se ek physical machine par kai virtual machines chalti hain.
Scalability: zaroorat parne par zyada resources jor sakna.
On-demand access: lambe setup ke intezar ke baghair jab chahein computing resources istemal karna.
IaaS servers, storage aur networking jaisa basic infrastructure pay-as-you-go (jitna istemal utna paisa) par deta hai.

PaaS cloud mein development aur deployment ka poora environment (kaam ki jagah aur tools) deta hai: infrastructure (servers, storage, networking), middleware, development tools aur management services.
Peer-to-peer (P2P) network mein computers (nodes) central server ke baghair aapas mein seedha communicate karte aur resources share karte hain.
